name: @tsuuanmi/system-lead-inbox
description: A project's lead inbox, from recorded events only: what needs the lead (a result or merge held, a question, spent retries, a landing that gave up, a request outside the lead's rights or stale, idle quota) and what finished (a live update, a landing, a digest), as lead-notice@1.0 records addressed to lead:<project>; MCP lead_inbox, system lead wait, and push to a command's stdin or a file; deduplicated, bounded, its outcomes recorded
